reasons: The cited paragraphs corroborate the 'missing' status: 9.3 cross-references a non-existent 'Section 20.5' for IP infringement remedies, 19.5 references an 'indemnity' duty, and 21.3 treats 'indemnification obligations' as Excluded Claims, yet no operative indemnity clause exists — that is walk-away territory under INDEMN (no Vendor IP indemnity at all).

The inserted Section 20 reaches the preferred position with model-language fidelity: Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, plus customary exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.

Placement and numbering are well chosen — inserted after the warranty/disclaimer section and numbered so that 20.5 restores the dangling 9.3 cross-reference — and the standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics are included.

The reciprocal Customer indemnity is drafted narrowly (Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law), exactly as the playbook's preferred position contemplates, so it does not create unwarranted exposure for our side.

The comment is accurate, concise, uses the required prefix and first-person plural, and correctly explains the gap and the cross-reference evidence; deterministic checks all pass. Minor note only: 'Vendor Technology' may not be a defined term in the Agreement and could be conformed to defined terms.
